name: FIAP Oficina - Jornada da Saga
description: Visao de progresso da Saga derivada dos eventos atuais. As contagens representam transicoes, nao ordens unicas nem status/historico completo de OS.

pages.name: Fluxo da Saga
pages.description: Atividade agregada por estado e etapa do process manager do OS Service.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM SagaTransition SELECT count(*) AS 'Transitions' FACET current_state TIMESERIES
FROM SagaTransition SELECT count(*) AS 'Transitions' FACET previous_state, current_state, event_type SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 100
FROM HttpRequest SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' WHERE service = 'os-service' AND path LIKE '%service-orders%' FACET path TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Chamadas de orcamento e pagamento no Billing

nrqlQueries.query: FROM HttpRequest SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' WHERE service = 'billing-service' AND (path LIKE '%quotes%' OR path LIKE '%payments%') FACET path TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Chamadas Mercado Pago registradas por codigo HTTP

nrqlQueries.query: FROM MercadoPagoRequest SELECT count(*) AS 'Recorded responses' FACET status_code TIMESERIES

rawConfiguration.text: Este painel usa somente eventos existentes. SagaTransition nao inclui order_id nem saga_id: nao ha contagem de OS unicas, drill-down por OS ou duracao por etapa. MercadoPagoRequest registra somente respostas retornadas com sucesso pelo client; erros do gateway nao aparecem nesse evento. A ingestao New Relic ainda precisa ser confirmada.
